speaker: Joseph
text: Pell. You're free. Your lanterns are exactly where you left them, which is the only thing in town I can say that about.

speaker: Joseph
text: Dova, your stall is untouched. The prices are the same as before. I checked. It seemed like the least I could do, and I did it.

speaker: Joseph
text: Brother Hask. The bell is still up there. So is the rope. I'd say it's a miracle, but I didn't file for one.

speaker: Joseph
text: Tamsin, you hear the Astral Plane. Tell me honestly how bad it is. Everyone else has been very polite about it, and it's no help.

speaker: Joseph
text: Yes, Pell, I saw the first signs. Yes, I put off reporting them. I'm now doing the work of the report, only louder.

speaker: Joseph
text: You were hollowed for a season and you want a refund. Dova, I admire that. I can't give you one, but I admire it.

speaker: Master Oss
text: Joseph. The order entrusted you with one duty: to report. You have since managed the rescue, the shifting and the regret. In that order, I note.

speaker: Tithe Clerk
text: Good day. A number of souls have left our care without form 7. We are not upset. We would simply like them back, at your earliest convenience.
